name: Magnetic Wireless Phone Holder with Foldable Suction Grip for Secure Mounting
description:
The Magnetic Wireless Phone Holder is designed with vacuum suction technology and upgraded magnetic strength to provide a strong, stable hold for your smartphone. Its foldable, dual-sided design makes it perfect for cars, kitchens, bathrooms, gyms, and offices—ensuring hands-free convenience wherever you are. Compact and portable, it adjusts to your preferred viewing angle and leaves no damage when removed. Compatible with all major smartphone brands, this holder offers unmatched stability and versatility.
Key Features
 Smart vacuum suction for ultra-secure grip
 Powerful dual-sided magnetic hold
 Foldable, space-saving, and portable design
 Adjustable viewing angle for convenience
 Works on glass, metal, tile, plastic, and more
 Universal compatibility with all smartphones
Ingredients / Materials
ABS body, strong magnet, vacuum suction cup, silicone pad
How to Use
 Stick the suction base onto a clean, flat surface
 Place your phone on the magnetic holder
 Adjust angle as per requirement
 Fold and carry when not in use
Package Includes
 1 × Magnetic Wireless Phone Holder
